{{Quote|Oh&hellip;is this on? Help! Emergency! This is Sand Crawler 345 broadcasting on Emergency Frequency. We are under attack from Tusken Raiders. . .setting emergency beacon&hellip;Help! Emergency!|[[FA-2PO]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:JT" />}}
'''Sand Crawler 345''' was a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was destroyed by [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]].<ref name="SWG:JT" />

==History==
{{Quote|My information has the Jawas, Valarians and Darklighters each have gotten a part of the shipment. I first want to track down the Jawa Sand Crawler and see what they have. They are on a trade route and I expect you can pick up their trail at Tosche Station.|[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Arlan Barrezz|Barrezz]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TS" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the Jawas of Sand Crawler 345 acquired a cargo that arrived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] from [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]]. The sandcrawler visited [[Tosche Station/Legends|Tosche Station]], near [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]], to have business with the warehouse manager [[Janus]].<ref name="SWG:TS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Tosche Station|Tatooine}}</ref> It then visited [[Zef Ando]] at the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]].<ref name="SWG:LH">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Lars Homestead|Tatooine}}</ref> After leaving the farm, Sand Crawler 345 was attacked by Tusken Raiders in the [[Western Dune Sea/Legends|Western Dune Sea]] and destroyed. Some Jawas and the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[FA-2PO]] managed to escape and took refuge nearby.<ref name="SWG:JT" /> As the cargo from Tansarii Point Station interested both [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Arlan Barrezz|Barrezz]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Carh'la Bastra|Bastra]],<ref name="SWG:TS" /> spacers were looking for the sandcrawler when it was attacked. The spacers received FA-2PO's emergency call and headed to the survivors of Sand Crawler 345. The spacers attacked the Tusken Raiders and rescued the Jawas. The spacers later recovered Jawa encryption keys from the Tusken Raiders and finally accessed to the sandcrawler database.<ref name="SWG:JT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sand Crawler 345 appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:JT" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Sand Crawler 345 was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
